data.title: 傍晚落地窗边的金色剪影

data.prompt: 1girl, solo, ayachi_nene, pearl white silk slip dress, sheer ivory silk robe, barefoot, standing by floor-to-ceiling window, fingertips on glass, profile turning toward viewer, soft serene smile, silhouetted figure, strong backlighting, glowing sunset sky, city skyline outside, long floor reflection, dark quiet interior, wide shot
data.animaCaption: Framed in dark silhouette against a blazing golden floor-to-ceiling window, she rests her fingertips on the glass and turns her face softly back toward the dim room. Sunset glare rims her sheer silk robe and stretches her reflection across the dark wooden floor.
data.promptProse: Shot wide from inside a quiet, shadowed apartment looking straight toward an expansive floor-to-ceiling window, Ayachi Nene stands barefoot in a pearl-white silk slip dress beneath a flowing sheer ivory robe. One hand rests lightly against the warm windowpane while she turns her profile toward the viewer with a tranquil smile; the intense golden-amber sunset outside turns her figure into a luminous rim-lit silhouette, making the sheer fabric edges glow while the darkened hardwood floor reflects the blazing city horizon.
data.story: 傍晚的整面落地窗像烧起来一样金亮，屋里没开灯，安静得只听见空调微风。宁宁赤脚站在窗玻璃前转过侧脸，逆光把真丝晨袍的边缘勾出一圈暖金——「不用急着开灯，陪我再看五分钟日落好不好？」
